name: Zocalo
description: A zócalo: the tiled dado round the foot of a wall, banded top and bottom.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; top: 40%; width: 100%; height: 46%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, #000 0 16%, transparent 16% 20%); mask: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, #000 0 16%, transparent 16% 20%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; top: 30%; width: 100%; height: 8%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); box-shadow: 0 calc(48px * 6 / @size-col) 0 @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
